library:1f3d47474090c137.text:
A dimensional barrier that enveloped the Blue Earth and its surroundings.
Created by the Neo Spacequake, it gradually altered the laws of the world so that the passage of time for living beings would approach zero.

library:e3f1a13e8884a61a.text:
A special forces unit belonging to Sidereal. Its commander is Gadlight Meonsam, and its deputy commander is Annalotta Stohls. Its main fighting force consists of Angeloi GEM and Diosc units.
Although sent to watch over the Blue Earth's Prison of Time, the unit is acting on Gadlight's own authority to wipe out humanity on Earth.

library:9c5f8ebdda1fb030.text:
Chrono's dominant faction, whose members call themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution.
The Reformists, led by Advent, are working to overthrow them.

library:840a9a3f2fc3d130.text:
Former chairman of the United Nations Peacekeeping Council in ADW and, subsequently, supreme commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
As chairman, he founded a special international rescue force that worked across organizational and political boundaries for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
His strong resolve made him willing to accept immediate sacrifices, but his forceful methods and hidden intentions also aroused suspicion.
Much about him remained mysterious, including records claiming that he had lived for over 200 years, though their authenticity was uncertain.
His true identity was one of the beings known as The Edel Bernal, who had come into contact with the Chrono H.
Near the end of the Regeneration War, he gave his life to entrust humanity's future to those who would follow him.

library:a54619ab7152adfe.text:
A faction opposed to the methods of Chrono's dominant Conservatives.
Whereas the Conservatives proclaim themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution, the Reformists describe themselves as its guardians.
Advent, commander of their field unit, serves as their de facto leader, though they once had a different leader.

library:4fea1475590954ee.text:
Refers to the independent force fighting Geminis on the Blue Earth.
Advent places great hopes in them and has assisted them on many occasions.

library:a1102a70d2cee402.text:
The independent force that brought the Multiverse War in UCW to an end.
Its name is an abbreviation of Z Emergency Union of Terrestrial Human, meaning an emergency relief alliance for humanity on Earth.
It fought The Edel Bernal, who sought to control the multiverse according to his own desires. After the Multiverse War, the group reunited to fight the Executors.
Later, some members were transported to ADW by Calamity Birth, the spacequake that accompanied the appearance of the King of Destruction there. They fought through the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War in ADW before returning to UCW through the Abyss.

library:0eab0fa83e0079ae.text:
An independent force that fought through the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War in ADW.
It was formed during the Destruction Incident by Elgan Rhodic, chairman of the United Nations Peacekeeping Council. Its name is an abbreviation of Z EXtra International Savers, meaning a special international rescue force.
After the spacequake known as Calamity Birth, members of ZEUTH who had been transported from UCW also joined it.
The force disbanded after the Destruction Incident, but was later reformed. As an independent external unit, it was given the right to act autonomously, along with inspection and enforcement authority over other Earth Federation units.
By defeating the leaders of various hostile organizations, it brought both interdimensional wars, the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War, to an end.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

library:1fde1d8828fa4a7b.text:
Refers to Captain Denzel Hammer, commander of Glory Star, the combat tactics research team to which Setsuko belongs.
Setsuko knows two Denzel Hammers, counterparts from parallel worlds. Both are commanding officers she respects and comrades with whom she has shared hardship and happiness.

library:b86be0dc14a1bf40.text:
His full name is Toby Watson.
A pilot and deputy chief of Glory Star, he holds the rank of first lieutenant and pilots Virgola Unit II.
Cheerful and talkative, he keeps the team's spirits up. On the battlefield, however, he is the first to charge into enemy lines, coolly assessing the situation and relentlessly cornering enemy units.
He comes from a particular parallel world in which only Virgola Units I and II exist.
That world's Glory Star was conducting evaluation trials of the Gunnery Carver, which did not contain a Sphere. Asakim arranged for them to meet Setsuko in order to inflict psychological harm on her.
After many twists and turns, he formed a team with Setsuko, and they began fighting together to complete the Virgola.

library:fa4ace740af67043.text:
A combat tactics research team in the Earth Federation Forces' lunar garrison, established to evaluate and perform shakedown tests on new machines.
Its current main duties are testing the Virgola Glory's all-environment multipurpose weapons system, the Gunnery Carver, for mass production and developing combat patterns for its use.
The team consists of Captain Denzel Hammer, its commander, First Lieutenant Toby Watson, and Second Lieutenant Setsuko Ohara.

library:81fc7d4fa0ff47cb.text:
Mysterious devices that control Dimensional Power.
Each corresponds to one of the twelve zodiac constellations and manifests its power in response to a particular movement of the human spirit.
They are generally installed in mobile weapons as power sources, but can also be used as superweapons as they reach more advanced stages of operation.

library:dca2337ce3b0fd87.text:
A collective name for organizations that exist in the various parallel worlds and have manipulated human history from the shadows.
Membership is hereditary. Each has a supreme authority called the King and a decision-making body known as the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing factions, the Conservatives and the Reformists, who respectively call themselves the watchers and guardians of humanity's evolution.
The Conservatives are dominant and wield considerable influence in politics, business, and the military.

library:e021654704d2dcd1.text:
A massive spacequake that united UCW, ADW, and other worlds.
Despite its immense scale, physical damage was relatively limited. Because UCW and ADW had similar cultures, they quickly understood the situation and were able to cooperate. As a result, the vast political organization known as the Earth Federation, including the space colonists, was formed in just three months, and everyday life soon became peaceful again.
It was later discovered, however, that this spacequake had also created the Prison of Time.

library:297d39f99b9d5b1c.text:
A special forces unit of the Britannia Union military in ADW.
True to its name, meaning an arsonist, it secretly and illegally fanned the flames of conflicts around the world. Each member possessed advanced intelligence skills and mobile weapon piloting abilities to carry out difficult missions.
Over time, however, its members became increasingly uncontrollable and left the military in what amounted to desertion.
Those who remained were deeply disturbed people who could live only on the battlefield or regarded war as the ultimate game. Nevertheless, every one of them swore an almost worshipful loyalty to their commander, Marilyn Cat.
After leaving the military, they operated as mercenaries under Marilyn. During the Regeneration War, they fought in the service of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum.
Following Marilyn's death, the survivors continue their mercenary work, but they have lost much of their former strength. Their achievements and notoriety are increasingly things of the past.

library:546920fea55068a5.text:
Refers to Marilyn Cat, former commander of Firebug.
An exceptional pilot and commander, she was at her best leading coordinated group attacks. She was also a master of the military martial art Systema and served as her troops' instructor.
Her mottos were 'In this world, whoever takes action wins' and 'Every girl is a princess.'
Cruel and capricious, she would carry out any atrocity in the name of a mission or contract. Extremely selfish and imperious, she made her subordinates call her Princess and used her supposed frailty as a woman to justify indulging her every whim.
She appeared to be a teenage girl dressed in Gothic Lolita fashion, but this was the result of cosmetic surgery and physical modification. Her true age was far greater.
Her background is unknown, though it is believed that her talent as a soldier led to her undergoing some form of enhancement surgery.
Her outfit also served as combat gear, with numerous devices concealed throughout it. As she put it, 'A girl's skirt is full of secrets.'
Drawn to Prince Uther's resolve, she pledged her support as his comrade and died fighting at the ZONE on Mars.
library:546920fea55068a5.notes: The motto この世はやったもん勝ち does not say first or describe speed/initiative. Remove the added first; preserve the opportunistic action-wins meaning. The rest of the description remains unchanged, including names.

library:568f903d92f3201f.text:
The amount of debt Crowe discovered he owed after the Regeneration War ended: the usage fee for the CDS, or Coin Drop System.
He learned of it after parting with Setsuko and Rand, so neither knew about it.

library:7f031394153c91bf.text:
A dimensional hole created by Aim Liard near the end of the Regeneration War, linking parallel worlds.
Its state was closely tied to the movements of the galaxy's stars. When it appeared, it connected ADW and UCW.
After the Regeneration War, the members of ZEUTH used the Abyss to return to their home world, UCW.
Calculations at the time indicated that the Abyss would become unstable again and that UCW and ADW would reconnect in approximately one year.
It vanished as a result of the Neo Spacequake.

library:8d497138094919ba.text:
Mysterious creatures that appeared in ADW from another dimension.
They are also called DAMONs, an abbreviation of their formal designation, Dimension-Armed MONster, and are divided into classes by type.
Initially treated as disasters that occurred at random through dimensional quakes, they were revealed to be a form of biological weapon when the New Empire Imperium appeared.
Their true forms are mobile weapons and their pilots, transformed by Gaiou, the King of Destruction.
After the Destruction Incident, the Dimensional Beasts broke free of control and resumed their sporadic appearances, once again being classified as first-class disasters.

library:193ac9bcadfa95cc.text:
Refers to the CDS, or Coin Drop System, installed in Crowe's Li Brasta during the Regeneration War.
It plays the sound of a falling coin to restore Crowe's awareness when he suffers the backlash of the Swaying Scales Sphere. For the sake of realism, however, it uses an actual coin drop, costing 1 G every time it is activated.
As a result, Crowe found himself saddled with another enormous debt after the Regeneration War ended.

library:3701197123ea0dd5.text:
A collective term for extradimensional energy existing between parallel worlds. It is also called the power of the Origin Principle, or Origin Law.
The first stage of using Dimensional Power is to extract energy from another dimension, producing quantities of energy impossible under ordinary physics. Earth's current spacetime physics has already reached a level where this can be controlled to some extent.
Its ultimate use, however, is to understand and control the energy that constitutes the world itself. This can also be described as controlling phenomena. If the facts that make object A what it is can be freely controlled, object A can be transformed into object B. Likewise, controlling the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to form water would allow water to be created from entirely different elements.
The clearest example is a spacequake, which disregards space and time to alter the very existence of a world. In other words, spacequakes are caused by Dimensional Power.
This is what is called a miracle: in effect, an omnipotent power. That remains a theoretical conclusion, however, with no clear prospect of experimental proof. Research into Spheres suggests that the will of living beings plays a part in extracting and controlling Dimensional Power.

library:88bb28bee90b217c.text:
Its formal name is the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum.
An absolute monarchy that had unified the Earth of a parallel world, it possessed roughly 2,000 years of history.
Its defense organization, the ArcSabers, followed a strictly defensive policy and protected humanity from other life-forms and aliens, but was defeated by the King of Destruction. The kingdom was then destroyed when the Dimensional Power extraction system ZONE ran out of control.
Later, under the command of the next Holy King, Uther Insaraum, its forces invaded ADW, only to be defeated by ZEXIS. By taking all responsibility for the war upon himself, Uther ensured that Insaraum's civilians would be accepted, and they became settlers on Mars.
Insaraum's research into Dimensional Power was more advanced than that of ADW or UCW, but many of its achievements were lost with the death of its central researcher, Ambrone Zius.

library:d48fa4d1f2a834fa.text:
A Dimensional Power extraction system developed by Ambrone Zius of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum. Its name is an abbreviation of Zodiac Of New Energy.
Installed along ley lines, it draws out the Dimensional Power within the planet. In Insaraum, however, ZONE ran out of control and left the land dead.
Five installations were built on Earth and one on Mars during the Regeneration War. All still exist, but none are operational.

library:0d6e8451ceca1afb.text:
Refers to the Regeneration War, which took place in ADW roughly one year after the Destruction Incident, as depicted in The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z: Regeneration Chapter.
As the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, which had ruled the Earth of a parallel world, invaded in search of new land, internal conflicts in the Earth Federation and battles against hostile extraterrestrial species, including intelligent life, erupted simultaneously.
The fighting ended when ZEXIS, the Earth Federation Forces' independent external unit, slew Insaraum's leader and the revived Gaiou, King of Destruction.
library:0d6e8451ceca1afb.notes: 討ち取られ explicitly says the two leaders were killed. Defeated omits that outcome. All proper-name spellings are retained for the subsequent glossary pass.

library:666be53bd234d499.text:
His full name is Aim Liard.
The bearer of the Lying Black Sheep Sphere, he pilots the mobile weapon Arietis.
During the Destruction Incident, he summoned Gaiou, King of Destruction, to plunge the world into chaos and operated behind the scenes as the strategist of the New Empire Imperium.
He was believed to have died in the battle in Antarctica near the end of the incident, but his death was a deception created through the Sphere's power.
Pursuing his own aims, he supplied dimensional science to Ambrone Zius of Insaraum. Much of his intent remains unknown, but his linking of two worlds through the Abyss near the end of the Regeneration War appears to have served a purpose beyond hunting other Sphere bearers.
The Lying Black Sheep Sphere governs human lies, and its bearer likewise fills his words and actions with falsehoods, making his true intentions difficult to discern. Partly consumed by the Sphere, he becomes unable to say anything true, or indeed meaningful, when his emotions rise.
Aim Liard is an alias. His real name is Hamal Argo. Originally a researcher of the Lying Black Sheep Sphere, he was drawn into it because of his aptitude.
Near the end of the Regeneration War, Asakim Dowen rendered him powerless using the Inquisitive Goat Sphere, the natural enemy of the Lying Black Sheep. He was then slain by Uther Insaraum, ruler of the Holy Kingdom he had manipulated.

library:e0324ff1dcc0bb65.text:
His full name is Uther Insaraum.
The first prince of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, aged 24.
The son of the previous king, King Insaraum LXXII, he became Insaraum's ruler after his father's death, though he had not yet been crowned.
His people loved him for his kindness, thoughtfulness, and compassion. Yet he was also timid, allowing Ambrone, who became chancellor after Insaraum's destruction, to exercise unchecked power.
He had received a general education in martial arts, but regardless of his actual skill, his innate gentleness made him unsuited to real combat.
He enjoyed reading poetry and served as an honorary adviser to Insaraum's arts ministry.
The death of his trusted retainer Gerard awakened him to his duty, and he devoted everything to Insaraum's future.
That love awakened the Inexhaustible Water Bearer Sphere within the kingdom's sacred royal machine, The Insar.
He was finally defeated in the decisive battle at the ZONE on Mars, and Asakim took the Inexhaustible Water Bearer Sphere. His will, however, lives on through Marguerite and the people of Insaraum, who revere him as their last Holy King even more deeply than they did in life.

library:566dff929beeada2.text:
The price a Sphere Reactor pays for drawing out a Sphere's power.
When a Sphere is used merely as a power source, it causes no noticeable harm. Backlash begins once it reaches the stage of controlling phenomena.
The symptoms vary from Sphere to Sphere, but relate to the aspect of the human spirit it governs. For instance, the backlash of the Lying Black Sheep, which governs lies, makes its bearer unable to speak the truth.
Gadlight Meonsam, who calls himself a Third Stage Reactor, shows no apparent symptoms. This suggests that greater control over a Sphere suppresses the backlash until it eventually becomes harmless. Conversely, overcoming the backlash is believed to be a condition for a Reactor to advance to the next stage.

library:81a87355123ccc28.text:
His full name is Denzel Hammer.
A pilot and commander of Glory Star, he holds the rank of captain and pilots Virgola Unit I.
A seasoned veteran with extensive combat experience, he was appointed to lead Glory Star's new-machine evaluation trials because of his record.
Despite his imposing appearance, he is attentive to small details and takes good care of his subordinates. Naturally approachable, he is conscious of his age and responsibilities and strives to make sound judgments in any situation.
He is particularly fond of cold beer.
He comes from a particular parallel world in which only Virgola Units I and II exist.
That world's Glory Star was conducting evaluation trials of the Gunnery Carver, which did not contain a Sphere. Asakim arranged for them to meet Setsuko in order to inflict psychological harm on her.
After many twists and turns, he formed a team with Setsuko, and they began fighting together to complete the Virgola.

library:4478210c79fd1cfa.text:
Refers to Crowe's encounter with a certain person during the Destruction Incident in ADW.
The man, apparently a repairman, escaped after Crowe saved his life on the battlefield.
His extraordinarily fiery smile left a strong impression on Crowe.

library:fb5787844d33b72b.text:
Gunleon's full combat form.
Parts across its body unfold, greatly increasing its output.
This form cannot be used until the Sphere reaches the Second Stage. Because it also places a heavy burden on the occupants, Ciero Beater had installed a mechanical seal. Rand broke that seal midway through the Multiverse War in UCW, unleashing its tremendous combat power.

library:2809c2614f8515b6.text:
His full name is Asakim Dowen.
A young man who committed a terrible sin in the past, he is forbidden even to die and wanders through countless spacetimes with Shurouga.
To escape this fate, he seeks the power of Taiji and has joined the battle among the bearers of Spheres, fragments of Taiji's will.
He was sealed inside the ZONE on Mars near the end of the Regeneration War.

library:dda79d8f6415581f.text:
Her full name is Esther Elhas.
A Dimensional Beast Buster working for Scott Lab, she is the sole survivor of Odis, the rural North American town where the first Rhinodamon-class Dimensional Beast appeared.
That harrowing experience left her with intense anger and hatred toward Dimensional Beasts, but her encounters with many people gradually restored her naturally open and honest personality. For better or worse, however, she tends to jump to conclusions, and her enthusiasm sometimes gets her nowhere.
After the Destruction Incident, she traveled the world in her Brasta Es, exterminating Dimensional Beasts wherever they appeared.
During the Regeneration War, she was transformed into an artificial Dimensional Beast, but miraculously recovered. Several mysteries remain concerning her body.

library:55d5f77f5f28f65c.text:
A mark branded on those destined to be tossed about by spacequakes. It is read as 'Stigma.'
Its meaning, its specific effects, and even what sort of people are chosen to bear it and by whom are all unknown.
At present, former members of ZEUTH and ZEXIS are said to bear it.

library:a7e97a1ba97f8d08.text:
Her full name is Marguerite Pistail.
A member of the ArcSabers of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world, she holds the rank of High Knight Number 7 and pilots the Pearl Nail.
Before the King of Destruction devastated Insaraum, she commanded the royal guard that protected the king's family. Her dignified bearing in public made her the flower of the ArcSabers, admired by the people.
After Insaraum's destruction, Aim Liard's intervention brought her into the service of the King of Destruction.
Proud and uncompromising in her principles, she prefers fair and honorable combat. While serving the New Empire Imperium, she therefore followed the ruthless Aim's orders only reluctantly.
As an ArcSaber, she renewed her oath of loyalty to Uther, but ultimately chose to fight him for the justice she believed in and the future of her homeland.
After Uther's fall, she understood his true intentions, became Insaraum's leader, and departed for Mars with its 500 million people.

library:8581931f0b5ea6b9.text:
The jet-black humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Asakim Dowen.
It boasts extraordinary mobility, using its speed to bewilder its enemies. Its primary weapon is the demon king's sword, Discalibur.
It can also transform into a high-speed cruising form. A perpetual-motion engine serves as its main power source, and it demonstrates various extraordinary abilities, but its technology and development history remain shrouded in mystery.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

library:ed4b4def1c918ae8.text:
A mysterious young man who pilots the mobile weapon Asclepus.
He is the field commander and de facto leader of the Chrono Reformists, who call themselves the guardians of humanity's evolution.
He always wears a warm smile and has a calm, graceful manner.
His true aims and those of the Reformists remain unknown. Toward Geminis, the power behind the Chrono Conservatives, however, he takes a resolute stance that at times borders on arrogance.
He describes himself as one of the cursed and says that he comes from another world, pursuing 'Tenshi.'

library:eebbd9904d897064.text:
A pilot in the Earth Federation Forces' combat tactics research team, Glory Star. She holds the rank of second lieutenant.
Earnest and conscientious, she works hard to fulfill any duty or role assigned to her. Her lack of confidence and timid nature once made her hesitant, and she privately questioned whether military life suited her. Through her experiences, however, she has grown more positive in her outlook.
She has careful, precise piloting skills and is responsible for developing combat patterns and evaluating new machines.
She enjoys visiting different places to sample their desserts.
Although she bears the Sorrowful Maiden Sphere, she has the inner strength to resist the fate it brings.
Her beloved Virgola Glory symbolizes her precious bonds with her teammates and is, in a sense, her other half.
library:eebbd9904d897064.notes: 担当している states her assigned responsibilities, not merely her suitability for those duties. Restore the actual assignment while keeping the rest of the description unchanged.

library:bc2d46488377b944.text:
A man who runs the wandering repair business Beater Service.
A generous, boisterous, hot-blooded man, he calls himself The Heat. When his temper rises, however, he often goes too far, earning him the nickname The Crusher behind his back. He hates that name, and hearing it immediately sours his mood.
With a drink after work as his greatest pleasure, he devotes himself to his repair business while traveling the ravaged land with Mel in search of his missing mentor, Ciero.
He bears the Wounded Lion Sphere but pays little attention to the fate it entails. He regards his Gunleon as a vital tool of his trade and has little interest in the Sphere that supplies its immense power.

library:bba56dbf28ba9441.text:
The daughter of Rand's mentor, Ciero Beater. Despite her childlike appearance, she is 18 years old.
Strong-willed and playful, she enjoys keeping a diary.
She has known Rand since he became Ciero's apprentice and calls herself his fiancée.
At Beater Service, she handles sales, accounting, and the work log, while also serving as Gunleon's sub-pilot.
She was once fused with the Sphere, and her lack of physical growth was thought to be the result of time standing still for her. Judging by her condition since being freed from it, however, her natural constitution seems to have been the main reason.

library:75a1b9af2df80aa6.text:
A Dimensional Beast Buster working for Scott Lab.
During the Destruction Incident, he fought for freedom and peace in his Brasta and managed to pay off an enormous debt.
He tries to act like a cynical rogue, but cannot keep up the pose for long, making him something of a comically flawed heartthrob. A man of many talents, he is also an accomplished fighter outside the cockpit, using the military martial art Systema.
He claims to dislike women and openly declares that he does not trust beautiful ones. The reason lies in his past, but he refuses to discuss it.
He regrets his former service in the military special forces unit Firebug and dislikes having it brought up.
After the Destruction Incident, he made a living as a salaried Dimensional Beast Buster, exterminating the creatures around the world. A new debt then drove him back into battle.
During that struggle, he and his new machine, Li Brasta, awakened to the Swaying Scales Sphere. Even so, he could not escape his fate of perpetual debt.

library:68d2d2bcf4d1405b.text:
The head of Scott Lab, a consultancy specializing in Dimensional Beasts.
An authority on robotics and energy engineering, she developed mobile weapons to combat Dimensional Beasts. She is now widely recognized as a leading expert in spacetime physics.
Completing her research is her primary motivation, and she will sacrifice everything else to achieve it. Her thinking is flexible and unconstrained by convention, though another way to put it is that she has little common sense and does everything entirely at her own pace.
She and Carlos Axion Jr., former president of the Axion Foundation, were university classmates and bitter rivals.
She favors Japanese clothing and has the peculiar habit of putting on the fox mask she carries whenever her true nature emerges.

library:9697a786ce727a32.text:
Deputy commander of the Chrono Reformists' field unit.
He serves as Advent's right-hand man and works tirelessly to live up to his expectations.
Intelligent and sensible, he also possesses the strength of mind to remain calm in any situation.
His cooking skills are on a professional level.

library:7d2d49c4b393a839.text:
A female member of the Chrono Reformists' field unit.
Her main duty is rear-line support, but she fights bravely whenever she takes to the front.
Gentle by nature, she rarely volunteers her own opinions and acts according to the orders of her commander, Advent.
She also has medical training and serves as a medic.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

library:6dae376cea376557.text:
A member of the Chrono Reformists' field unit.
Quiet and rarely inclined to assert personal views, this member faithfully carries out Advent's orders.

library:6665ed59b9760b77.text:
A member of the Chrono Reformists' field unit.
An honest, unassuming person, prepared to suffer injury for Advent's sake.
Extensive mechanical knowledge also makes this member a valuable contributor to maintenance and repairs.

library:0c4d142e7db1c8c9.text:
A Sphere researcher working for Sidereal.
As one of its lowest-ranking researchers, she was frustrated at being unable to pursue her studies as she wished.
Although timid and lacking in self-esteem, once she makes up her mind she can act with surprising determination, sometimes astonishing those around her.

library:5b2d83f1dbcc1d59.text:
A Sphere researcher working for Sidereal.
As one of its lowest-ranking researchers, she was frustrated at being unable to pursue her studies as she wished.
Although timid and lacking in self-esteem, once she makes up her mind she can act with surprising determination, sometimes astonishing those around her.
She joined Crowe's group to further her research into the Spheres and developed a quiet affection for Crowe, who had helped her gain confidence.
However, a timed mind-control program had been implanted in her. It magnified the hatred born of her inferiority complex, turning her into the pilot of An-Arles, which houses the Resentful Scorpion Sphere.
Crowe and his companions rescued her, but the aftereffects of the mind control caused her to lose her memories.
Afterward, she joined the Resistance's support staff and began a life with no connection to the Spheres.

library:f19f2f2e726e8206.text:
A deserter from Sidereal.
An easygoing, carefree, good-natured middle-aged man, he is surprisingly well educated and occasionally displays his extensive knowledge.

library:279a7a0b28bffca5.text:
A deserter from Sidereal.
An easygoing, carefree, good-natured middle-aged man, he is surprisingly well educated and occasionally displays his extensive knowledge.
His true identity is the deputy commander of Antares, Sidereal's special forces unit. He had been accompanying Setsuko's group as an undercover operative.

library:e5c653b8a1db9097.text:
A mysterious boy with no past.
His skill at piloting mobile weapons suggests that he was used in some kind of biological weapon experiment.
He is always cynical, radiating hostility and keeping others at a distance.
Setsuko named him Orion after the stars shining in the night sky.

library:6ed65c4aca87e1ea.text:
A mysterious boy with no past.
His skill at piloting mobile weapons suggests that he was used in some kind of biological weapon experiment.
He is always cynical, radiating hostility and keeping others at a distance.
Setsuko named him Orion after the stars shining in the night sky.
His true identity is Barbiel the Needle, the Sphere Reactor of the Resentful Scorpion. He revealed his name after Clavier was rescued.

library:1d65eb31e9c6c1c7.text:
A Sidereal unit commander.
Extremely conceited, he calls himself a brilliant strategist and employs all manner of schemes. His plans are poorly finished, however, and he is bad at responding to unexpected developments.
He favors dramatic turns of events and speaks in a distinctive, theatrical manner.
His subordinates have little faith in him, and some call him the last man they would want as a superior.

library:bd3486dd68dfaef2.text:
Commander of Antares, a Sidereal special forces unit.
Extremely conceited, he calls himself a brilliant strategist and employs all manner of schemes. His plans are poorly finished, however, and he is bad at responding to unexpected developments.
He favors dramatic turns of events and speaks in a distinctive, theatrical manner.
His subordinates have little faith in him, and some call him the last man they would want as a superior.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

library:e114dc1f51b688eb.text:
An officer of Sidereal, the interstellar military alliance, and the Sphere Reactor of the Taciturn Crab.
He pilots the enormous mobile weapon Shiseiten.
A man of few words, he shows no emotion even in battle, yet the killing intent he radiates overwhelms those around him. By embodying laws different from those of this world, he turns his bare hands into lethal blades, slicing his targets apart while extinguishing the flame of life.
These powers make him Sidereal's executioner of traitors.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

library:fc6b525b81b0a5ff.text:
Commander of Geminis.
The Reactor of the Quarreling Twins Sphere, he pilots Geminia, the most powerful mobile weapon of the planet Geminai. He is also the strongest Geminaid warrior. Like the other members of Geminis, he channels his psychokinetic powers directly into piloting, but his abilities far surpass theirs.
Using his Sphere, he can reverse the conflicting emotions latent within people, and has used this to sow chaos throughout the Earth Sphere. His ultimate goal is to make humanity destroy itself.
Originally sent to Earth to watch over the Prison of Time, he became intensely jealous of the planet. Though Earth had no future, it was protected from Baal's attacks, while his own home world, Geminai, had been destroyed by an unknown force. He therefore abandoned his duty and sent Geminis to pursue the opposite goal: humanity's annihilation.
Fond of idleness and alcohol, he usually wastes his time in a bar, watching the turmoil he has caused. His deputy, Annalotta, frequently scolds him for his slovenly behavior, but he has no intention of changing. This is, however, a way of disguising his fierce anger and his resignation at having no outlet for it. That duality activates the Quarreling Twins Sphere, which responds to opposing emotions.
He describes his awakening as a Sphere Reactor as the Third Stage, beyond the levels reached by Uther Insaraum and Aim Liard.

library:075911acb73dddf0.text:
Deputy commander of Geminis.
A calm, capable commander and a first-rate mobile weapon pilot, she channels her psychokinetic powers directly into the controls to achieve extraordinary combat performance.
She is utterly ruthless in carrying out her duties and is capable of acts that could be called cruel and inhuman when dealing with an enemy.

library:60845943e621e0ff.text:
An upgraded version of the Virgola, developed as a prototype for the Earth Federation Forces' next mass-production machine. It was designed to operate the Gunnery Carver, an all-environment multipurpose weapons system.
The original Virgola had a flexible joint structure and highly responsive controls capable of meeting the needs of everyone from rookies to veterans. Dr. Jie Beibel of Chimera tuned the servo motors and actuators in each joint, while the VWFS, or V-Wing Flight System, enabled atmospheric flight, giving it remarkable mobility.
After obtaining the machine, Sidereal's researchers added booster pods to increase the VWFS's output, greatly raising its maximum speed.
Sidereal, whose Sphere research is far more advanced than Earth's, also added a Sphere control system to the Gunnery Carver. Designed both to draw out Dimensional Power more efficiently and to communicate the user's will directly to the Sphere, it brought Setsuko and the Sphere into even closer unity, unlocking exceptional attack power.
Earth technology was used extensively in the upgrades, suggesting that Sidereal was experimenting with weapons technology it had acquired from Earth.
The S in its name stands for Star. Setsuko chose it as an expression of Glory Star's pride.

library:73bb530e69154990.text:
Beater Service's repair machine.
Its original main pilot was Ciero Beater, but Rand now fills that role.
Using the various tools mounted across its body and the enormous handheld Riot Jar Wrench, it repairs everything from small machines to large ships.
Its tremendous combat power also means Beater Service is often hired as a bodyguard when major fighting breaks out.
The cockpit seats two and includes modest living facilities. It is both an essential tool of Beater Service's trade and their home.
Through the awakening of the Wounded Lion and Gunleon's own will, it can now remain in Magna Mode, with its entire body enveloped in a flame-like aura. Mel complains about the heat, though the aura is not actual fire. Rand, on the other hand, is delighted with this added feature.
Magna Mode switches off when Rand is not aboard, so it causes no problems in the hangar.

library:21e315a369f9bfce.text:
The final completed form of Li Brasta, combining the close-combat Red and ranged-combat Blue variants, and an experimental machine exploring an entirely new approach. The T in its name stands for Trial.
Its basic tactical concept follows Blue's emphasis on ranged combat. Its main armament is therefore the AX-99 RAPTOR, a new electromagnetic acceleration gun precision-test model for next-generation weapons research, equipped with miniaturized SPIGOTs: spatial probability field interference devices for moving and transforming objects.
At the same time, its frontal armor and joints have been reinforced to make use of data gathered from Red, allowing it to handle close combat as well.
This runs counter to the earlier concept of improving combat power through tactical specialization. Instead, it combines the active use of the Sphere's control over phenomena in its weapons with an approach that fully exploits Crowe's versatility. On paper, the completed machine surpasses both Red and Blue in every combat situation.
However, the extra weight compared with Blue was compensated for by increasing output. This raised its speed but made changes of course more difficult, producing a demanding machine that requires even greater piloting skill from Crowe.
Like the previous versions, it also carries the CDS, or Coin Drop System, to draw out the full power of the Swaying Scales Sphere.

library:fd121251a659c14a.text:
The humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Advent.
Its high mobility and well-balanced armament, combined with Advent's skill, allow it to perform exceptionally in any situation.
Its development history is shrouded in mystery, but it uses Dimensional Power in some form as its energy source. Its output and control over phenomena rival those of Sphere-equipped machines.
The Chrono Reformists also use a mass-production version, which likewise boasts considerable combat power.

library:34ecebbd016c8e36.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the Chrono Reformists' field unit.
It carries almost the same armament as the Asclepus on which it is based and boasts high performance. Its excellent handling also allows Chrono members with little combat experience to fight on the front lines.

library:4c106c1810f241d4.text:
A customized Across piloted by Setsuko.
Along with increased output to improve aerial combat performance, its Plasma Launcher has been modified for both ranged and close combat. It fights using the GS Combat Action techniques developed with the Virgola Glory.
Its color scheme also follows the Virgola's, and its heroic presence has become a beacon of hope for the local Resistance.

library:5177e622fe6f1e4c.text:
A customized Across piloted by Setsuko.
Along with increased output to improve aerial combat performance, its Plasma Launcher has been modified for both ranged and close combat. It fights using the GS Combat Action techniques developed with the Virgola Glory.
Its color scheme also follows the Virgola's, and its heroic presence has become a beacon of hope for the local Resistance.
After Setsuko switched to the Virgola Glory S, the machine was entrusted to a boy in the Resistance.

library:94bfb08a07650a6c.text:
A mobile weapon the Axion Foundation was developing as its next flagship product.
Whereas its bestselling Axio specialized in ground combat, this machine was designed primarily for aerial combat to compete with other manufacturers' products.
After seizing the production lines, Sidereal manufactured it in large numbers and deployed it to the front, mostly under AI control.
Manned versions also existed for research and testing. Clavier piloted one that she seized.

library:efd3b35a665d61d1.text:
A customized Ranbolt piloted by Rand.
It was tuned with a single-minded emphasis on increasing power, at the cost of poorer fuel efficiency.
It also carries a full set of repair tools, allowing it to handle both repair work and Beater-style combat techniques.
Rand piloted a Ranbolt during his apprenticeship at Beater Service, so memories of those days tend to make him a little reckless in battle.

library:0e73ab7b8835d4cb.text:
A customized Ranbolt piloted by Rand.
It was tuned with a single-minded emphasis on increasing power, at the cost of poorer fuel efficiency.
It also carries a full set of repair tools, allowing it to handle both repair work and Beater-style combat techniques.
Rand piloted a Ranbolt during his apprenticeship at Beater Service, so memories of those days tend to make him a little reckless in battle.
Although badly damaged in combat, its wreckage was placed on display in the town square as a tribute to the hero that had defended the town.

library:36bcfeeab57026e5.text:
A customized Axio Nightbird tuned by Traia.
Its weight was reduced, greatly improving both maneuverability and mobility.
Given to Crowe while the Li Brasta was being readjusted, it carries Brasta weapons and has been tuned to suit his fighting style.
It is equipped with a switchable turbocharger. By briefly raising the machine's output, Crowe's skill allows him to perform Assault Combat Pattern Faiz alone, even though the technique normally requires a group.

library:c430b84dbfcae33f.text:
A customized Axio Nightbird tuned by Traia.
Its weight was reduced, greatly improving both maneuverability and mobility.
Given to Crowe while the Li Brasta was being readjusted, it carries Brasta weapons and has been tuned to suit his fighting style.
It is equipped with a switchable turbocharger. By briefly raising the machine's output, Crowe's skill allows him to perform Assault Combat Pattern Faiz alone, even though the technique normally requires a group.
It was shot down in the battle against Shikuu, leading to the summoning of Li Brasta T, but also saddling Crowe with a new debt.

library:eefc9f8db7239603.text:
A commander version of the Schauras used by Antares, a special forces unit of the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
With its sturdy armor and specialized weapons, it closes in on enemies and damages both their machines and their pilots.
As a commander model, it has its own color scheme and improved performance in various areas.

library:9647aa9f5fef2012.text:
A commander version of the Schauras used by Antares, a special forces unit of the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
It is piloted by Saldias, Antares's deputy commander.
With its sturdy armor and specialized weapons, it closes in on enemies and damages both their machines and their pilots.
As a commander model, it has its own color scheme and improved performance in various areas.

library:68f9ea95577b674d.text:
A mobile weapon used by a special forces unit of the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
A higher-grade machine than the Angeloi, it combines sturdy armor with specialized weapons to close in on enemies and damage both their machines and their pilots.

library:0a8fa69139d0d1bb.text:
A mobile weapon used by Antares, a special forces unit of the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
With its sturdy armor and specialized weapons, it closes in on enemies and damages both their machines and their pilots.
Developed following the incorporation of Barbiel and An-Arles into Sidereal, it is one of the alliance's relatively new machines. Technology from An-Arles is used throughout its design, including weapons that employ combat nanomachines.
Across the various fronts, its name inspires fear alongside that of Antares. Its very presence was feared and loathed beyond what its raw combat power alone would warrant.

library:fd3e16b113d1e359.text:
A transport ship developed and sold by the Axion Foundation.
Usable both inside and outside the atmosphere, it became widespread thanks to its convenience and flexibly configurable cargo containers.
It carries a minimal armament and can also be used in combat.
After seizing its production lines, Sidereal began mass-producing the ship for deployment to the front.

library:35da33aae2b32e49.text:
A captured Gratia-class transport formerly used by Sidereal.
Its exterior was repainted, and Code: Red of the Chrono Reformists operated it as the mothership for Advent's group.

library:93e18006c122f53c.text:
A captured Gratia-class transport formerly used by Sidereal.
Its exterior was repainted, and Code: Red of the Chrono Reformists operated it as the mothership for Advent's group.
During the battle for Central Base in the northern part of the central continent, it made a suicidal charge to save Advent and his companions, perishing along with Red.

library:ad7da908dba90757.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by Sidereal.
It is generally unmanned and controlled by AI.
Although it appears fragile, its simple construction and complete lack of concern for an occupant's safety allow it to ignore a certain amount of damage, giving it considerable durability.
Its attack power is inferior to the Angeloi's, but that durability, combined with tactics based on overwhelming numbers, makes it a significant threat.

library:c8377552fa4cdf23.text:
Sidereal's latest mass-produced mobile weapon.
It is generally unmanned and controlled by AI.
Compared with the Demon, which follows the same design concept, its firepower and durability are greatly improved. Its overall combat power rivals that of a standard-issue Angeloi.

library:e0acdadd4615bd4f.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
It is primarily operated by a pilot.
Its articulated frame is covered by armor with a flexible structure. This armor incorporates an energy-release mechanism and can change shape as needed to serve as a weapon.
The high mobility afforded by its construction, combined with its powerful weapons, gives it combat capabilities in a class apart from Earth-made machines.

library:d11e8c43ee5d005e.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
This color scheme identifies the version operated by the special forces unit Antares.
Its articulated frame is covered by armor with a flexible structure. This armor incorporates an energy-release mechanism and can change shape as needed to serve as a weapon.
The high mobility afforded by its construction, combined with its powerful weapons, gives it combat capabilities in a class apart from Earth-made machines.

library:e5cce340963014af.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
This color scheme identifies the version operated by the special forces unit Kishuku.
Its articulated frame is covered by armor with a flexible structure. This armor incorporates an energy-release mechanism and can change shape as needed to serve as a weapon.
The high mobility afforded by its construction, combined with its powerful weapons, gives it combat capabilities in a class apart from Earth-made machines.

library:aa93469828db5332.text:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the interstellar military alliance Sidereal.
This color scheme identifies the version operated by the special forces unit Geminis.
Its articulated frame is covered by armor with a flexible structure. This armor incorporates an energy-release mechanism and can change shape as needed to serve as a weapon.
The high mobility afforded by its construction, combined with its powerful weapons, gives it combat capabilities in a class apart from Earth-made machines.

library:282eb1a8d22abfb3.text:
The mobile weapon piloted by Gadlight, equipped with the Quarreling Twins Sphere.
Developed for Gadlight, the strongest pilot on the planet Geminai, it brings together the world's finest technology. Its Sphere was still being analyzed when installed, but Gadlight's awakening as a Reactor revealed its many functions and brought Geminia to completion.
Its basic design follows the Diosc, sharing its psychokinetic controls, light-particle weapons, and exceptional close-combat performance. Combined with Gadlight's powerful psychokinesis, outstanding piloting skill, and the Sphere's Dimensional Power, however, these features produce overwhelming combat strength. In theoretical calculations, it rivals an entire battalion of Diosc units.
Its use of the Sphere's control over phenomena is concentrated on improving mobility and maneuverability and ensuring that its attacks strike home. Although this may appear understated compared with other Sphere-equipped machines, every aspect serves the single aim of delivering a lethal blow, producing attack power that overwhelms even those other machines.

library:4f5d3d5c5062d575.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by Geminis, a special forces unit belonging to Sidereal.
Developed on the planet Geminai, it is a high-end machine that was issued preferentially to the elite Geminis unit.
Version A is a commander model, piloted by Annalotta.
Its human-machine interface, known as psychokinetic control, channels each Geminis pilot's psychokinesis directly into operation. Each machine is therefore finely tuned to its pilot.
Its weapons use light particles extracted through Dimensional Power. Combined with the responsiveness and mobility of its psychokinetic controls, they give it extraordinary close-combat abilities. Command Arts, which reproduce Geminai's traditional martial arts through the machine, are especially effective in mobile weapon combat. Alongside Geminia, the Diosc that performs them was a symbol of strength to the Geminaids.

library:27793bb7b4041b5b.text:
A mass-produced mobile weapon used by Geminis, a special forces unit belonging to Sidereal.
Developed on the planet Geminai, it is a high-end machine that was issued preferentially to the elite Geminis unit.
Its human-machine interface, known as psychokinetic control, channels each Geminis pilot's psychokinesis directly into operation. Each machine is therefore finely tuned to its pilot.
Its weapons use light particles extracted through Dimensional Power. Combined with the responsiveness and mobility of its psychokinetic controls, they give it extraordinary close-combat abilities. Command Arts, which reproduce Geminai's traditional martial arts through the machine, are especially effective in mobile weapon combat. Alongside Geminia, the Diosc that performs them was a symbol of strength to the Geminaids.

library:04c8b9ee3756a5e8.text:
An autonomous mobile artillery platform.
Although slow, it boasts a long firing range and excels at defending strongholds.
Originally an Earth-made weapon, it was improved by Sidereal after the alliance seized its production lines and is now used as an inexpensive fighting force.

library:5826908d118557ca.text:
A mobile weapon the Axion Foundation was developing as its next flagship product.
Whereas its bestselling Axio specialized in ground combat, this machine was designed primarily for aerial combat to compete with other manufacturers' products.
Its armament also shifted from projectile weapons to optical weapons, with an eye toward the next generation of warfare.
Development stopped when the Axion Foundation dissolved, but other companies bought the design and began mass production.
After seizing those production lines, Sidereal manufactured it in large numbers and deployed it to the front, mostly under AI control.

library:f5ed23c51dc80f44.text:
A multipurpose machine used primarily on the Green Earth.
Employed in construction and underwater work as well as combat, it is renowned for its power, ease of maintenance, and strong frame.
Although it comes with no dedicated handheld weapons, it can use various weapons provided their specifications match its manipulators.
After seizing its production lines, Sidereal manufactured it in large numbers and deployed it to the front, mostly under AI control.
library:f5ed23c51dc80f44.notes: 専用の手持武装は用意されていない says that dedicated handheld weapons are not provided. It does not assert that such weapons were never developed. Keep the compatibility condition unchanged.

library:804a7a864314ea51.text:
A mobile weapon developed and sold by the Axion Foundation.
Distributed through many sales channels, it was adopted by the militaries of smaller nations lacking their own weapons development capabilities, as well as mercenary organizations and even terrorists. Numerous variants exist.
Its strengths are good handling, considerable versatility, and a wide selection of optional weapons. Its highly automated controls also support AI operation, allowing it to serve as an unmanned machine.
Although its performance meets a respectable standard, more skilled pilots have increasingly found it inadequate.
Licensed companies continued producing and selling it after the Axion Foundation's dissolution. With little hope of further upgrades, however, it is gradually losing its position as a primary combat machine to other weapons.
Sidereal has now seized its production lines and is mass-producing it for front-line deployment, mainly under AI control.

library:fa2c77fe73c38af3.text:
A customized version of the bestselling humanoid mobile weapon Axio.
An extremely expensive special-operations model, it features extensive weight reduction and improved stealth and communications.
It has been Firebug's preferred machine since the unit's military days and carries the electromagnetic close-combat weapon EM Dagger.
Although the standard Axio is known for its easy handling, Firebug further tunes this model, giving it highly sensitive controls. Conversely, the unit's ability to handle it as naturally as their own limbs means its members can pilot virtually any mobile weapon.
Burglar means a robber; the name under which the Axion Foundation sold the machine was Nightbird.

library:8f044c44b618725c.text:
A mobile weapon equipped with the Resentful Scorpion Sphere.
Its enormous rear-mounted unit, the Brandai, is a control system for multipurpose nanomachines.

library:f370be9713247834.text:
A mobile weapon equipped with the Resentful Scorpion Sphere.
Its enormous rear-mounted unit, the Brandai, is a control system for multipurpose nanomachines.
Clavier was only a temporary pilot. When Barbiel the Needle, the true Reactor of the Resentful Scorpion, took the controls, it demonstrated overwhelming power far beyond anything it had shown before.

library:4807828e029b5208.text:
The mobile weapon piloted by Shikuu, Sphere Reactor of the Taciturn Crab.
Its name is read as Shiseiten.
Resembling the carcass of an enormous creature, its appearance and the silent pressure exerted by its pilot dominate the atmosphere of the battlefield.
It boasts powerful weapons and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.

interface:5a4118f010673e22.text:
Chimera, the secret organization that controlled the UCW's wars from the shadows.
The membership badges its operatives wore supposedly amplified human desires...
or perhaps they didn't.

interface:0399332af1cb5f49.text:
A fabled treasure said to hold the fighting spirit of the warriors who fought through the Destruction Incident.
Some say it was made as a charm to soothe the anger and grief
of those the King of Destruction turned into Dimensional Beasts.

interface:60bcacf35f9bf404.text:
A fabled treasure said to hold the people's wish for the world's rebirth at the end of the Regeneration War.
Some say it embodies the feelings of the prince who risked his life for his people
and of those who supported him.

interface:ba745cd57749abf5.text:
One of the secret treasures passed down through the lost Holy Kingdom of Insaraum.
Said to embody King Insaraum I's love for his people,
it grants its bearer great power just once.

interface:d91189210dd3b9d5.text:
One of the crowning achievements of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum's dimensional science.
It draws out Dimensional Power using the user's will and life force as a key,
enhancing the weapons of the machine they pilot.

interface:e563033967bce3d9.text:
An integrated tactical information AI system using quantum computation.
Nearby allied machines can link to the unit carrying it
to receive precise tactical guidance.

interface:79eed4e5e1f8ac4d.text:
A universal repair and resupply system that applies Dimensional Power.
By creating something from nothing to replace missing parts or replenish ammunition,
it can service machines of any type.

interface:73dfbcc088e886f3.text:
An autopilot system specialized in defensive action.
Its AI contains recorded movements of an extremely timid small animal from a certain star system,
allowing it to choose the best defensive response faster than human reflexes.

interface:a4705dd155eb7ce4.text:
A reward system that pays funds based on distance traveled.
It piggybacks on a promotion in a certain star system that awards perks based on pedometer readings.
Once that promotion ends, the system will stop working.

interface:69548ea043f47b87.text:
A retaliation system that makes opponents taste the pain its user has suffered.
Once installed in many mobile weapons in a certain star system, it proved difficult to use properly.
So many users misjudged their limits and destroyed themselves that it was discontinued.

interface:b1ba64d31894152e.text:
A system that forcibly applies spiral theory to every weapon.
The benefits of spiral theory are still being studied. Some researchers insist
that the increase in power is a psychological effect of the pilot's enthusiasm for manly dreams.

interface:442ee5c6f7571ecb.text:
A system that extracts Dimensional Power through dimensional crystals.
It can provide enormous amounts of energy, but the constant risk of a runaway reaction
places an immense mental strain on the pilot.

interface:fa6d9694de5f732f.text:
A system that generates dimensional quakes in an extremely small area.
It distorts the surrounding space for use in various defensive mechanisms,
though some users experience symptoms similar to motion sickness.

interface:69cd9826a7225022.text:
A movement assistance system that uses entry into and exit from subspace.
It is a form of pseudo-teleportation requiring less energy than travel between parallel worlds,
with the added thrill of wondering whether you might never return.

interface:4ee7725abf6a6ff7.text:
A system that amplifies the exhilaration of defeating an enemy.
It stimulates the release of pleasure-producing chemicals in the brain, creating an intensely pleasant feeling.
Using it therefore requires a strong sense of self-discipline.

interface:3053ee3c6c519702.text:
A system that makes users feel a stronger bond with their partner.
Originally developed to improve relationships between married couples in a rut,
it attracted attention for its potential use with any pair of people and was put into practical use.

interface:96232d213169755a.text:
A system that draws Dimensional Power from human life force itself.
Doing so requires Focus to be raised to its absolute limit,
so the user must possess the strength to match.

interface:16d2d0fac2172387.text:
Insaraum's ZONE technology miniaturized to fit inside a machine.
It draws out the Dimensional Power present everywhere and affects all allied machines.
Because it may run out of control, it can only be used once per deployment.

interface:84b060b812e3b93e.text:
A combat enhancement system based on the physical data of Dimensional General Gaiou.
It strengthens the machine in proportion to the pilot's growth, but exceeding its limits
forces the pilot to merge with the machine, leading to a horrific end.

interface:625faa10f4d3fca8.text:
A system that extracts Dimensional Power through dimensional crystals.
It replenishes ammunition rather than energy, but improper use risks
causing rounds to collide inside the magazine and set off a chain explosion.

interface:3d9edbb16cf50afb.text:
A system that increases weapon range by sending the energy of a shot through hyperspace.
The shot's trajectory disappears and suddenly reappears just in front of the target.
Veteran pilots find this especially disorienting, and improvements are needed.

interface:0a801fcc72863025.text:
The membership badge of a special forces unit blamed for igniting the wars of the ADW.
Besides serving as an ID card, it doubled as membership in its female commander's fan club.
Members could receive various perks based on their combat achievements.

interface:3177c8db9b4a0d4a.text:
A system that frees a person's persona.
Wearing the mask releases users from concern for appearances, shame, and shyness, letting them show a side they normally conceal.
However, serious-minded people tend to feel depressed from the backlash after taking it off.

interface:5ef261dd703f9b6d.text:
A collection of Dimension Jokes used by dimensional merchants across time and space.
It can put a wide circle of people at ease at once, but these are ultimately one-shot gags.
Repeating them only makes the audience angry.

Only the main unit attacks.
This also applies when using an ALL weapon that attacks all units in the enemy team.
When using an ALL weapon against a two-unit enemy team, attack power
is multiplied by 0.75.
●Center Attack
Both sub and main units attack one unit in the enemy team.
The sub unit uses its assist weapon at 1.0 times normal attack power,
and the main unit gains +20% hit rate.
The unit targeted by a Center Attack performs the counterattack.

menu_resource:d82ffdccd3278000.text: ●Major Battle Systems Added or Changed in This Game

menu_resource:305ad18371b349f8.text: ①Tag Commands      The new Tag Command 1"Boost Dash"1 has been added.

menu_resource:8521cc7926536a2a.text: Using Boost Dash increases Movement by 5

menu_resource:3d15f961fea6bb04.text: and ignores movement penalties from terrain.

menu_resource:4593b508b2ac6419.text: It also lets you move even when enemy teams

menu_resource:6677cca69289ad15.text: surround you on all four sides.

menu_resource:ab29abadb6751e05.text: ②Tactical Combo    In Jigoku-hen, when an allied team finished its action,

menu_resource:f10a0191830db4f9.text: if it failed to wipe out the enemy team, the Combo Gauge

menu_resource:66ff372147da3e78.text: In this game, after using the unit commands Maximum Break,

menu_resource:60a4480af0e68657.text: Attack, or Song, if you fail to wipe out the enemy team,

menu_resource:735f71b9cbb5b953.text: the Combo Gauge falls by 1. However,

menu_resource:c18060a72cc5e29e.text: ③Maximum Break    In Jigoku-hen, when using Maximum Break

menu_resource:266d6ee462131702.text: with both the main and sub units attacking with ALL weapons,

menu_resource:f21a3a85affdd407.text: if the sub unit's attack destroyed only the enemy team's

menu_resource:bc3f51d5cc20b329.text: main unit, the battle ended at that point.

menu_resource:d939abfe95fe6109.text: In this game, even in the same situation,

menu_resource:84a36fecd7390a27.text: battle continues 1if the enemy team's sub unit remains1,

menu_resource:2e1e0a843e40ac19.text: and the allied team's main unit follows up with its attack.

menu_resource:91548dbe6fcc82c1.text: ④Erosion    A special weapon effect possessed by some enemies.

menu_resource:c27c94cac817e34f.text: When a unit takes damage from such a weapon,

menu_resource:3eaa46d1cda1b357.text: If a pilot affected by this effect has

menu_resource:fd599f8b10a5360b.text: 80 or less Focus after battle, the unit is treated as

menu_resource:6225b604b5d4cbb5.text: destroyed regardless of its remaining HP.

menu_resource:28aec7f3fca9c93d.text: ●A new menu added to 1D-Trader1 during intermissions.

menu_resource:cd3a71bc536c85f9.text: ●In Z Crystal, you can spend 1Z Chips1 to upgrade the Z Crystal,

menu_resource:3c906b9134b221b3.text: giving 1your entire force various effects according to its upgrade level1.

menu_resource:f208214dec9e2fc8.text: ●The Z Crystal has GRADE levels from 0 to 5,

menu_resource:b726090f6cc10b8d.text: and each increase adds more effects.

menu_resource:7fed5a9ee814c99c.text: ●GRADE 0 (the initial state) has no effect. Effects begin

menu_resource:5f4342555f266688.text: GRADE 4 and GRADE 5 each offer three effects. When upgrading,

menu_resource:42375307881be86c.text: choose one of them. You cannot change the effect after confirming it.

menu_resource:971f85825b1bd080.text: surround you on all four sides.

menu_resource:79cbdc421fa6bc74.text: ●During the player phase, wiping out an enemy team (destroying all

menu_resource:4d8a9e1ab716710f.text: units belonging to it) raises the Combo Gauge by 1, to a maximum of 5.

menu_resource:0985b5842f3b333d.text: ●When an allied team attacks while the Combo Gauge is raised,

menu_resource:d2f8a84119cd4e26.text: wiping out the enemy team raises the gauge by another 1,

menu_resource:6e68cd672d2c9b36.text: while failing to wipe it out lowers the gauge by 1.

menu_resource:c520172619d6a717.text: The Combo Gauge resets to 0 at the end of the ally phase.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:d909a228724de693.text: Actions other than attacking (such as Move, Wait, Repair, or Resupply)

menu_resource:b7bdadac2f0635db.text: do not raise or lower the Combo Gauge.

menu_resource:4e5578c4935b2f35.text: ●For each point of Combo Gauge, allied units gain these bonuses.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:6b2f4fb8f8250f62.text: 1Final damage dealt to enemy units: x1.05 (maximum x1.25)1

menu_resource:3a38da8d6b44e14d.text: 1Funds and Z Chips earned for destroying enemy units: x1.05 (maximum x1.25)1

menu_resource:8aa943527963d866.text: ●The current Combo Gauge is shown in the Overall Command.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:6e290cc51e83ca24.text: ●A Game Over restarts that map from the beginning.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:c8d15f09785d5087.text: 1Funds and experience earned on that map before Game Over carry over1.

menu_resource:18403afe7c39f8ba.text: Kills, PP, Z Chips, and Power Parts do not carry over.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:b3e69a601779ac95.text: Also, retrying after a Game Over forfeits that SR Point.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

menu_resource:3f6a339a96f3f387.text: ●A unit command available only to Basara.

menu_resource:a042a54b6266fbe6.text: Basara's unit, the VF-19 Custom Fire Valkyrie,

menu_resource:09a710c4440e144d.text: 1has the Song command in place of Attack1.

menu_resource:7e382268c385e0a8.text: Basara also has the unique stats Song Energy and Song Soul.

menu_resource:bffc45154d42a98b.text: ●Starting Song Energy is determined by Basara's level, Song Soul,

menu_resource:89c880af023ab84e.text: and Focus at deployment. Higher values yield higher starting Song Energy.

menu_resource:536fdde643b84482.text: ●Song Energy increases at the start of the player phase, when Focus rises,

menu_resource:a875317b4a689b3b.text: through battle participation, and according to battle results. Higher values strengthen songs.

menu_resource:d35737e190878005.text: Singing consumes Song Energy, but normal songs

menu_resource:69a316ac32cac39c.text: increase it by more than they consume. As a result, the more you sing,

menu_resource:2cb027063f61b67d.text: the higher your Song Energy becomes.

menu_resource:81b4c15aaacc3c11.text: ●A song's effect depends on the pilot it targets.

menu_resource:ad375a62f9142451.text: 1. Allied Pilots    1Depending on the track, it raises stats or applies Spirit Commands1,

menu_resource:bade2c234b0af2ce.text: If Basara has the Spirit Command Valor active,

menu_resource:3da59df6d4f98d31.text: If the Spirit Command Soul is active,

menu_resource:4c0b35e69065b8c5.text: it provides the same increase as Valor.

menu_resource:f9710228a7e0c384.text: 2. Enemy Pilots    1Regardless of the track, there is either no effect, reduced Focus,1

menu_resource:9d71efcd76f211ca.text: The effect received depends on the enemy pilot.

menu_resource:3dc64503b10c7adf.text: 1Only pilots affected by Focus reduction alone (excluding damage1

menu_resource:1ba10f7c8cc98f6f.text: 1together with Focus reduction) will retreat if a song1

menu_resource:00a3f0f0cdcfabc8.text: Enemies that retreat count as Song Kills,

menu_resource:170c98445f590356.text: granting kills, experience, funds, Z Chips, and other rewards

menu_resource:199f275e9728361c.text: just like destroying them with weapons.

menu_resource:8d24a9bf694fedaa.text: Song damage increases with a higher Song Soul stat

menu_resource:ab662b33414bdb08.text: or the effects of the Spirit Commands Valor and Soul.

menu_resource:6dfe09b636d3d806.text: ●To view each song's special effects, press SELECT on the

menu_resource:57ff02c5858e1120.text: ●A unit command available only to the allied mothership 1Solarian1.

menu_resource:663d78b63f719e5f.text: The available commands correspond to the Z Crystal's GRADE,

menu_resource:b8312df12a3a0294.text: with more commands becoming available as its GRADE increases.

menu_resource:9bbaa2e0e07758e8.text: ●The effects chosen at Z Crystal GRADE 4 and 5

menu_resource:df2b95b5e2feae56.text: do not affect which D Commands are available.

menu_resource:6832c759f61a27ad.text: ●The unit command D Command can be used 1only once per phase1,

menu_resource:2216c98efcb7bd29.text: and 1a D Command that has been used cannot be used again1

menu_resource:186edb35afc39a41.text: ●The power of pilot and machine united, drawn out by the Z Crystal.

menu_resource:75d9d2f083931e2c.text: ①The Focus limit increases from 150 to 12001.

menu_resource:064d9fd3e1cee924.text: Special Skills, Power Parts, and songs can raise the limit beyond 200.

menu_resource:ab9fc3c7af76a781.text: ●A tutorial panel containing various information about 1Team Formation1.

menu_resource:e4475550860c28e2.text: While the tutorial panels accessed from Combat Record mainly cover

menu_resource:d3213b2c4ada8117.text: systems used on maps, this panel explains team formation

menu_resource:01e9e26cf699434c.text: ●The number of team slots has increased to 1601.

menu_resource:7d23f6c63a0db3ea.text: ●Team slots 1scroll vertically as you move the cursor1,

menu_resource:9bbfc641327fd568.text: with up to 30 teams displayed per screen.

menu_resource:8ef49a88b8a81be5.text: ●During Team Formation, pick up a unit with ○, then

menu_resource:bb168b8655a2da01.text: press 1□1 over a slot occupied by another unit

menu_resource:719613d7f377bd52.text: to 1swap the positions1 of the held unit and the selected unit.

menu_resource:aaf7f3c011c9fdcb.text: ●1Compact Teams and Tutorial Panel1 have been added to the Support Menu.

menu_resource:fb2a094fae0a43eb.text: ●Units deployed by an event on the next map are placed in

menu_resource:112bf637cd60fed2.text: 1event deployment slots1 between the battleship and team slots.

menu_resource:74774793c1123aba.text: ●Event deployment teams cannot use Sort or Team Name.

menu_resource:e6a536cecc104322.text: Depending on the map, Refit Parts and Reassign Pilot may also be unavailable.

menu_resource:ac6821b0efb30632.text: ●After clearing a map, event deployment teams are 1disbanded1. Their units

menu_resource:68014efb8820fe29.text: are automatically assigned to 1empty spaces found by searching from the end of the team slots1.

menu_resource:810c1430fc351ece.text: ●If the sub side of an event deployment slot displays a 1Free1 icon,

menu_resource:2ac8a3ca16256149.text: it is a FREE slot, 1where you may freely assign a sub unit1.

menu_resource:11f9aee457e12213.text: If it displays a 1Fix1 icon, 1you cannot add a sub unit1

menu_resource:2230664ef173dc48.text: ●A support function that forms teams automatically.

menu_resource:e648eac24721dd57.text: ●You can still adjust team formation manually after using Auto Formation.

menu_resource:1d92561d9d56235d.text: ●Auto Formation has 1two options: Basic Order and Balance Order1.

menu_resource:2fbaa3f2a7351384.text: ①Basic Order    Prioritizes pairings from the original series.

menu_resource:6b0027983e5d7730.text: It applies to 1all teams1, changing them to preset

menu_resource:33776ab55c975dd0.text: You can also preserve selected teams

menu_resource:487ea233619d36f6.text: by excluding them from Auto Formation.

menu_resource:1535d0025deb442c.text: ●Organizes team slots by closing gaps left by empty slots.

menu_resource:602c9c4ba1ee2e1e.text: ●You can select slots to exclude from compaction (to keep them empty).

menu_resource:a5b506ee503b723a.text: ●Organizes team slots by changing the order of whole teams.

menu_resource:73b27f8138a43514.text: ●There are two sorting methods: 1Move Mode and Swap Mode1.

menu_resource:67379b42a26dc08d.text: ①Move Mode    Inserts the selected team at the destination.

menu_resource:27091cfa4fc3b028.text: ②Swap Mode    Exchanges the selected team with the team at the destination.

menu_resource:41a38ec9d7cd19ac.text: ●1Marks units and mechs that match your search criteria1.

menu_resource:72a550864b3c2596.text: ●The three search categories are 1Spirit Commands, Special Skills, and Special Abilities1.

menu_resource:308a859357865a1e.text: ●You can register up to five search criteria.

menu_resource:f3956865b4baf5a2.text: ●A support function that 1restores every team's formation to its state1

menu_resource:8ac83a9f88e1ec87.text: ●Team slot edits, name changes, pilot reassignments, transformations, Refit Parts,

menu_resource:7640fb86c3530856.text: and Power Part assignments revert to their original state.

menu_resource:291ba646224e2f5c.text: ●1Pilot Training and unit/weapon upgrades are not undone1.

narration:66bde5d10ab3b577.text: Existing in separate spacetimes, they were called parallel worlds,

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:104c697aec849daa.text: and were never meant to intersect.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review
exact Japanese source; requires context review
exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:a5c33ff6eae7e32f.text: A tremendous spacequake in one world

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:a3417f06e396e24c.text: destroyed the dimensional barriers separating the worlds.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:96f4b95ca8d6277d.text: As a result, countless parallel worlds merged together,

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:509e5abfc1587141.text: giving birth to many new worlds.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review
exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:68e34308e630f557.text: The birth of new worlds brought new encounters,

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:e621155acb8ea808.text: and new encounters brought new conflicts. Many

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:83f11dbae5cc2b14.text: multiverses remained in chaos long after their birth.

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:2e88b3f5992b5c9b.text: Yet in some of them, a new order gradually

reference.match: exact Japanese source; requires context review
exact Japanese source; requires context review

narration:0399a2d39b539108.text: The worlds known as UCW and ADW

narration:b29ebaa25bc64d3c.text: merged with others to create a new Earth...

narration:60aa92186f87b457.text: Enclosed by a dimensional barrier created by the alien Geminaids,

narration:13ced38aea827bae.text: it had become a Prison of Time.

narration:07807bb809cb52e5.text: Within it, brave warriors stood beside their comrades,

narration:b406356a58ab6d44.text: fighting desperately to save their world.

narration:75e6498b0e27c536.text: Meanwhile, at that very same time...

narration:31dbd32b16cac9dd.text: On another Earth beyond the dimensional barrier,

narration:cd33919797ec54e7.text: Advent, field commander of the Chrono Reformists,

narration:f216dd5fd28da17f.text: The Reactors prepared to set out on a new journey of battle.

narration:726d0d0bdae64fd4.text: Meanwhile, on the other Earth, the battle against Geminis

narration:12eb6e8e8768beaf.text: And the struggle over the Spheres that the Reactors had foreseen

narration:483459a620fff26a.text: had already begun, exceeding anything they had imagined.

narration:6062d3a85ae26499.text: When the Prison of Time falls, every parallel world will be drawn

narration:6a833bffa4d22502.text: into the true battle that is about to begin...
