A dimensional hole created by Aim Liard near the end of the Regeneration War, linking parallel worlds.
Its state was closely tied to the movements of the galaxy's stars. When it appeared, it connected ADW and UCW.
After the Regeneration War, the members of ZEUTH used the Abyss to return to their home world, UCW.
Calculations at the time indicated that the Abyss would become unstable again and that UCW and ADW would reconnect in approximately one year.
It vanished as a result of the Neo Spacequake.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:0d6e8451ceca1afb.text:
Refers to the Regeneration War, which took place in ADW roughly one year after the Destruction Incident, as depicted in The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z: Regeneration Chapter.
As the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, which had ruled the Earth of a parallel world, invaded in search of new land, internal conflicts in the Earth Federation and battles against hostile extraterrestrial species, including intelligent life, erupted simultaneously.
The fighting ended when ZEXIS, the Earth Federation Forces' independent external unit, slew Insaraum's leader and the revived Gaiou, King of Destruction.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:0d6e8451ceca1afb.notes: 討ち取られ explicitly says the two leaders were killed. Defeated omits that outcome. All proper-name spellings are retained for the subsequent glossary pass.

interface:666be53bd234d499.text:
His full name is Aim Liard.
The bearer of the Lying Black Sheep Sphere, he pilots the mobile weapon Arietis.
During the Destruction Incident, he summoned Gaiou, King of Destruction, to plunge the world into chaos and operated behind the scenes as the strategist of the New Empire Imperium.
He was believed to have died in the battle in Antarctica near the end of the incident, but his death was a deception created through the Sphere's power.
Pursuing his own aims, he supplied dimensional science to Ambrone Zius of Insaraum. Much of his intent remains unknown, but his linking of two worlds through the Abyss near the end of the Regeneration War appears to have served a purpose beyond hunting other Sphere bearers.
The Lying Black Sheep Sphere governs human lies, and its bearer likewise fills his words and actions with falsehoods, making his true intentions difficult to discern. Partly consumed by the Sphere, he becomes unable to say anything true, or indeed meaningful, when his emotions rise.
Aim Liard is an alias. His real name is Hamal Argo. Originally a researcher of the Lying Black Sheep Sphere, he was drawn into it because of his aptitude.
Near the end of the Regeneration War, Asakim Dowen rendered him powerless using the Inquisitive Goat Sphere, the natural enemy of the Lying Black Sheep. He was then slain by Uther Insaraum, ruler of the Holy Kingdom he had manipulated.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:4478210c79fd1cfa.text:
Refers to Crowe's encounter with a certain person during the Destruction Incident in ADW.
The man, apparently a repairman, escaped after Crowe saved his life on the battlefield.
His extraordinarily fiery smile left a strong impression on Crowe.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:2809c2614f8515b6.text:
His full name is Asakim Dowen.
A young man who committed a terrible sin in the past, he is forbidden even to die and wanders through countless spacetimes with Shurouga.
To escape this fate, he seeks the power of Taiji and has joined the battle among the bearers of Spheres, fragments of Taiji's will.
He was sealed inside the ZONE on Mars near the end of the Regeneration War.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:193ac9bcadfa95cc.text:
Refers to the CDS, or Coin Drop System, installed in Crowe's Li Brasta during the Regeneration War.
It plays the sound of a falling coin to restore Crowe's awareness when he suffers the backlash of the Swaying Scales Sphere. For the sake of realism, however, it uses an actual coin drop, costing 1 G every time it is activated.
As a result, Crowe found himself saddled with another enormous debt after the Regeneration War ended.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:1fde1d8828fa4a7b.text:
Refers to Captain Denzel Hammer, commander of Glory Star, the combat tactics research team to which Setsuko belongs.
Setsuko knows two Denzel Hammers, counterparts from parallel worlds. Both are commanding officers she respects and comrades with whom she has shared hardship and happiness.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:dca2337ce3b0fd87.text:
A collective name for organizations that exist in the various parallel worlds and have manipulated human history from the shadows.
Membership is hereditary. Each has a supreme authority called the King and a decision-making body known as the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing factions, the Conservatives and the Reformists, who respectively call themselves the watchers and guardians of humanity's evolution.
The Conservatives are dominant and wield considerable influence in politics, business, and the military.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:9c5f8ebdda1fb030.text:
Chrono's dominant faction, whose members call themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution.
The Reformists, led by Advent, are working to overthrow them.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:81a87355123ccc28.text:
His full name is Denzel Hammer.
A pilot and commander of Glory Star, he holds the rank of captain and pilots Virgola Unit I.
A seasoned veteran with extensive combat experience, he was appointed to lead Glory Star's new-machine evaluation trials because of his record.
Despite his imposing appearance, he is attentive to small details and takes good care of his subordinates. Naturally approachable, he is conscious of his age and responsibilities and strives to make sound judgments in any situation.
He is particularly fond of cold beer.
He comes from a particular parallel world in which only Virgola Units I and II exist.
That world's Glory Star was conducting evaluation trials of the Gunnery Carver, which did not contain a Sphere. Asakim arranged for them to meet Setsuko in order to inflict psychological harm on her.
After many twists and turns, he formed a team with Setsuko, and they began fighting together to complete the Virgola.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:dda79d8f6415581f.text:
Her full name is Esther Elhas.
A Dimensional Beast Buster working for Scott Lab, she is the sole survivor of Odis, the rural North American town where the first Rhinodamon-class Dimensional Beast appeared.
That harrowing experience left her with intense anger and hatred toward Dimensional Beasts, but her encounters with many people gradually restored her naturally open and honest personality. For better or worse, however, she tends to jump to conclusions, and her enthusiasm sometimes gets her nowhere.
After the Destruction Incident, she traveled the world in her Brasta Es, exterminating Dimensional Beasts wherever they appeared.
During the Regeneration War, she was transformed into an artificial Dimensional Beast, but miraculously recovered. Several mysteries remain concerning her body.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:297d39f99b9d5b1c.text:
A special forces unit of the Britannia Union military in ADW.
True to its name, meaning an arsonist, it secretly and illegally fanned the flames of conflicts around the world. Each member possessed advanced intelligence skills and mobile weapon piloting abilities to carry out difficult missions.
Over time, however, its members became increasingly uncontrollable and left the military in what amounted to desertion.
Those who remained were deeply disturbed people who could live only on the battlefield or regarded war as the ultimate game. Nevertheless, every one of them swore an almost worshipful loyalty to their commander, Marilyn Cat.
After leaving the military, they operated as mercenaries under Marilyn. During the Regeneration War, they fought in the service of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum.
Following Marilyn's death, the survivors continue their mercenary work, but they have lost much of their former strength. Their achievements and notoriety are increasingly things of the past.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:fa4ace740af67043.text:
A combat tactics research team in the Earth Federation Forces' lunar garrison, established to evaluate and perform shakedown tests on new machines.
Its current main duties are testing the Virgola Glory's all-environment multipurpose weapons system, the Gunnery Carver, for mass production and developing combat patterns for its use.
The team consists of Captain Denzel Hammer, its commander, First Lieutenant Toby Watson, and Second Lieutenant Setsuko Ohara.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:546920fea55068a5.text:
Refers to Marilyn Cat, former commander of Firebug.
An exceptional pilot and commander, she was at her best leading coordinated group attacks. She was also a master of the military martial art Systema and served as her troops' instructor.
Her mottos were 'In this world, whoever takes action wins' and 'Every girl is a princess.'
Cruel and capricious, she would carry out any atrocity in the name of a mission or contract. Extremely selfish and imperious, she made her subordinates call her Princess and used her supposed frailty as a woman to justify indulging her every whim.
She appeared to be a teenage girl dressed in Gothic Lolita fashion, but this was the result of cosmetic surgery and physical modification. Her true age was far greater.
Her background is unknown, though it is believed that her talent as a soldier led to her undergoing some form of enhancement surgery.
Her outfit also served as combat gear, with numerous devices concealed throughout it. As she put it, 'A girl's skirt is full of secrets.'
Drawn to Prince Uther's resolve, she pledged her support as his comrade and died fighting at the ZONE on Mars.

interface:546920fea55068a5.notes: The motto この世はやったもん勝ち does not say first or describe speed/initiative. Remove the added first; preserve the opportunistic action-wins meaning. The rest of the description remains unchanged, including names.

interface:88bb28bee90b217c.text:
Its formal name is the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum.
An absolute monarchy that had unified the Earth of a parallel world, it possessed roughly 2,000 years of history.
Its defense organization, the ArcSabers, followed a strictly defensive policy and protected humanity from other life-forms and aliens, but was defeated by the King of Destruction. The kingdom was then destroyed when the Dimensional Power extraction system ZONE ran out of control.
Later, under the command of the next Holy King, Uther Insaraum, its forces invaded ADW, only to be defeated by ZEXIS. By taking all responsibility for the war upon himself, Uther ensured that Insaraum's civilians would be accepted, and they became settlers on Mars.
Insaraum's research into Dimensional Power was more advanced than that of ADW or UCW, but many of its achievements were lost with the death of its central researcher, Ambrone Zius.

interface:8d497138094919ba.text:
Mysterious creatures that appeared in ADW from another dimension.
They are also called DAMONs, an abbreviation of their formal designation, Dimension-Armed MONster, and are divided into classes by type.
Initially treated as disasters that occurred at random through dimensional quakes, they were revealed to be a form of biological weapon when the New Empire Imperium appeared.
Their true forms are mobile weapons and their pilots, transformed by Gaiou, the King of Destruction.
After the Destruction Incident, the Dimensional Beasts broke free of control and resumed their sporadic appearances, once again being classified as first-class disasters.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:3701197123ea0dd5.text:
A collective term for extradimensional energy existing between parallel worlds. It is also called the power of the Origin Principle, or Origin Law.
The first stage of using Dimensional Power is to extract energy from another dimension, producing quantities of energy impossible under ordinary physics. Earth's current spacetime physics has already reached a level where this can be controlled to some extent.
Its ultimate use, however, is to understand and control the energy that constitutes the world itself. This can also be described as controlling phenomena. If the facts that make object A what it is can be freely controlled, object A can be transformed into object B. Likewise, controlling the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to form water would allow water to be created from entirely different elements.
The clearest example is a spacequake, which disregards space and time to alter the very existence of a world. In other words, spacequakes are caused by Dimensional Power.
This is what is called a miracle: in effect, an omnipotent power. That remains a theoretical conclusion, however, with no clear prospect of experimental proof. Research into Spheres suggests that the will of living beings plays a part in extracting and controlling Dimensional Power.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:e3f1a13e8884a61a.text:
A special forces unit belonging to Sidereal. Its commander is Gadlight Meonsam, and its deputy commander is Annalotta Stohls. Its main fighting force consists of Angeloi GEM and Diosc units.
Although sent to watch over the Blue Earth's Prison of Time, the unit is acting on Gadlight's own authority to wipe out humanity on Earth.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:4fea1475590954ee.text:
Refers to the independent force fighting Geminis on the Blue Earth.
Advent places great hopes in them and has assisted them on many occasions.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:840a9a3f2fc3d130.text:
Former chairman of the United Nations Peacekeeping Council in ADW and, subsequently, supreme commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
As chairman, he founded a special international rescue force that worked across organizational and political boundaries for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
His strong resolve made him willing to accept immediate sacrifices, but his forceful methods and hidden intentions also aroused suspicion.
Much about him remained mysterious, including records claiming that he had lived for over 200 years, though their authenticity was uncertain.
His true identity was one of the beings known as The Edel Bernal, who had come into contact with the Chrono H.
Near the end of the Regeneration War, he gave his life to entrust humanity's future to those who would follow him.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:fb5787844d33b72b.text:
Gunleon's full combat form.
Parts across its body unfold, greatly increasing its output.
This form cannot be used until the Sphere reaches the Second Stage. Because it also places a heavy burden on the occupants, Ciero Beater had installed a mechanical seal. Rand broke that seal midway through the Multiverse War in UCW, unleashing its tremendous combat power.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:a7e97a1ba97f8d08.text:
Her full name is Marguerite Pistail.
A member of the ArcSabers of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world, she holds the rank of High Knight Number 7 and pilots the Pearl Nail.
Before the King of Destruction devastated Insaraum, she commanded the royal guard that protected the king's family. Her dignified bearing in public made her the flower of the ArcSabers, admired by the people.
After Insaraum's destruction, Aim Liard's intervention brought her into the service of the King of Destruction.
Proud and uncompromising in her principles, she prefers fair and honorable combat. While serving the New Empire Imperium, she therefore followed the ruthless Aim's orders only reluctantly.
As an ArcSaber, she renewed her oath of loyalty to Uther, but ultimately chose to fight him for the justice she believed in and the future of her homeland.
After Uther's fall, she understood his true intentions, became Insaraum's leader, and departed for Mars with its 500 million people.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:568f903d92f3201f.text:
The amount of debt Crowe discovered he owed after the Regeneration War ended: the usage fee for the CDS, or Coin Drop System.
He learned of it after parting with Setsuko and Rand, so neither knew about it.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:e021654704d2dcd1.text:
A massive spacequake that united UCW, ADW, and other worlds.
Despite its immense scale, physical damage was relatively limited. Because UCW and ADW had similar cultures, they quickly understood the situation and were able to cooperate. As a result, the vast political organization known as the Earth Federation, including the space colonists, was formed in just three months, and everyday life soon became peaceful again.
It was later discovered, however, that this spacequake had also created the Prison of Time.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:a54619ab7152adfe.text:
A faction opposed to the methods of Chrono's dominant Conservatives.
Whereas the Conservatives proclaim themselves the watchers of humanity's evolution, the Reformists describe themselves as its guardians.
Advent, commander of their field unit, serves as their de facto leader, though they once had a different leader.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:81fc7d4fa0ff47cb.text:
Mysterious devices that control Dimensional Power.
Each corresponds to one of the twelve zodiac constellations and manifests its power in response to a particular movement of the human spirit.
They are generally installed in mobile weapons as power sources, but can also be used as superweapons as they reach more advanced stages of operation.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:566dff929beeada2.text:
The price a Sphere Reactor pays for drawing out a Sphere's power.
When a Sphere is used merely as a power source, it causes no noticeable harm. Backlash begins once it reaches the stage of controlling phenomena.
The symptoms vary from Sphere to Sphere, but relate to the aspect of the human spirit it governs. For instance, the backlash of the Lying Black Sheep, which governs lies, makes its bearer unable to speak the truth.
Gadlight Meonsam, who calls himself a Third Stage Reactor, shows no apparent symptoms. This suggests that greater control over a Sphere suppresses the backlash until it eventually becomes harmless. Conversely, overcoming the backlash is believed to be a condition for a Reactor to advance to the next stage.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:55d5f77f5f28f65c.text:
A mark branded on those destined to be tossed about by spacequakes. It is read as 'Stigma.'
Its meaning, its specific effects, and even what sort of people are chosen to bear it and by whom are all unknown.
At present, former members of ZEUTH and ZEXIS are said to bear it.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:8581931f0b5ea6b9.text:
The jet-black humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Asakim Dowen.
It boasts extraordinary mobility, using its speed to bewilder its enemies. Its primary weapon is the demon king's sword, Discalibur.
It can also transform into a high-speed cruising form. A perpetual-motion engine serves as its main power source, and it demonstrates various extraordinary abilities, but its technology and development history remain shrouded in mystery.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:b86be0dc14a1bf40.text:
His full name is Toby Watson.
A pilot and deputy chief of Glory Star, he holds the rank of first lieutenant and pilots Virgola Unit II.
Cheerful and talkative, he keeps the team's spirits up. On the battlefield, however, he is the first to charge into enemy lines, coolly assessing the situation and relentlessly cornering enemy units.
He comes from a particular parallel world in which only Virgola Units I and II exist.
That world's Glory Star was conducting evaluation trials of the Gunnery Carver, which did not contain a Sphere. Asakim arranged for them to meet Setsuko in order to inflict psychological harm on her.
After many twists and turns, he formed a team with Setsuko, and they began fighting together to complete the Virgola.

interface:1f3d47474090c137.text:
A dimensional barrier that enveloped the Blue Earth and its surroundings.
Created by the Neo Spacequake, it gradually altered the laws of the world so that the passage of time for living beings would approach zero.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:e0324ff1dcc0bb65.text:
His full name is Uther Insaraum.
The first prince of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum, aged 24.
The son of the previous king, King Insaraum LXXII, he became Insaraum's ruler after his father's death, though he had not yet been crowned.
His people loved him for his kindness, thoughtfulness, and compassion. Yet he was also timid, allowing Ambrone, who became chancellor after Insaraum's destruction, to exercise unchecked power.
He had received a general education in martial arts, but regardless of his actual skill, his innate gentleness made him unsuited to real combat.
He enjoyed reading poetry and served as an honorary adviser to Insaraum's arts ministry.
The death of his trusted retainer Gerard awakened him to his duty, and he devoted everything to Insaraum's future.
That love awakened the Inexhaustible Water Bearer Sphere within the kingdom's sacred royal machine, The Insar.
He was finally defeated in the decisive battle at the ZONE on Mars, and Asakim took the Inexhaustible Water Bearer Sphere. His will, however, lives on through Marguerite and the people of Insaraum, who revere him as their last Holy King even more deeply than they did in life.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:a1102a70d2cee402.text:
The independent force that brought the Multiverse War in UCW to an end.
Its name is an abbreviation of Z Emergency Union of Terrestrial Human, meaning an emergency relief alliance for humanity on Earth.
It fought The Edel Bernal, who sought to control the multiverse according to his own desires. After the Multiverse War, the group reunited to fight the Executors.
Later, some members were transported to ADW by Calamity Birth, the spacequake that accompanied the appearance of the King of Destruction there. They fought through the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War in ADW before returning to UCW through the Abyss.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:0eab0fa83e0079ae.text:
An independent force that fought through the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War in ADW.
It was formed during the Destruction Incident by Elgan Rhodic, chairman of the United Nations Peacekeeping Council. Its name is an abbreviation of Z EXtra International Savers, meaning a special international rescue force.
After the spacequake known as Calamity Birth, members of ZEUTH who had been transported from UCW also joined it.
The force disbanded after the Destruction Incident, but was later reformed. As an independent external unit, it was given the right to act autonomously, along with inspection and enforcement authority over other Earth Federation units.
By defeating the leaders of various hostile organizations, it brought both interdimensional wars, the Destruction Incident and Regeneration War, to an end.

reference.match: exact Japanese in Rengoku catalog; context review required

interface:d48fa4d1f2a834fa.text:
A Dimensional Power extraction system developed by Ambrone Zius of the Holy Kingdom of Insaraum. Its name is an abbreviation of Zodiac Of New Energy.
Installed along ley lines, it draws out the Dimensional Power within the planet. In Insaraum, however, ZONE ran out of control and left the land dead.
Five installations were built on Earth and one on Mars during the Regeneration War. All still exist, but none are operational.

menu_resource:1372c0cab5625832.text:
The son of Sozo Haran, inventor of the Meganoids and Megaborgs.
He deeply hates his father, who sacrificed his older brother and mother for experiments, and the Meganoids he created.
Several years before the story, he stole Daitarn 3, then being developed as a Meganoid prototype,
and escaped Mars. The vast gold reserves he brought allowed him to build a mansion outside Shin the City.
　Cheerful, bright, and full of humor, he is dependable and never forgets to joke even in a crisis.
His affected charm and confidence do not feel unpleasant because of the deeply human side
he occasionally reveals.
　His extraordinary physical prowess lets him fight Meganoids on equal terms even without a robot. His

during the final stages of the previous war.

on the Moon.

scenario:474a335da2672fcb.text:
Advent, the Chrono Reformists' field commander, breaks through
the Prison of Time with his subordinate Blue and descends to Green Earth.
After intercepting Sidereal forces there, Advent declares to Blue
that he will overthrow Sidereal.
They set out on a journey to find the Sphere Reactors
whose power will help them achieve that goal.

scenario:8c1d8e4801d0c0f7.text:
Piloting the Across Custom, Setsuko fights as a key member
of the Resistance. Gilter's underhanded scheme puts her
in danger, but Advent comes to her rescue.
Advent asks Setsuko to accompany him, despite her doubts
about his forceful methods.

scenario:ff35538e96386478.text:
Setsuko decides to set out with Advent.
They meet Rand, who continues working as a repairman despite
being separated from Mel, and invite him to join their journey.
Rand agrees to accompany them so that he can search for Mel
and the Gunleon.

scenario:188f48ceaf894bab.text:
Advent tells Rand and Setsuko about the situation on Blue Earth.
He predicts that they will encounter another Reactor.
On the battlefield, they meet Crowe, who is offering his services
to the Resistance, and add him to their group.
Advent explains his purpose to the three Reactors and tells them
that their next destination is Sidereal's Sphere
research facility.

scenario:b05a7db2c840cbca.text:
The group assaults a Sidereal base and wins, despite struggling
against the enemy's biological weapons, the Insects.
After taking the base, they meet the Sphere researcher
Clavier and a mysterious boy who does not know
who he is.

scenario:9a976f94801a0f33.text:
Clavier defects from Sidereal to pursue her Sphere research
and offers to help the group.
The group fights to protect Saldias, a deserter from Sidereal,
with help from the mysterious boy.
Setsuko names the boy Orion, and he and Saldias
join the group.

scenario:6a0a6661dac51b64.text:
The group attempts to capture the Terminal Base that controls
the surrounding region, but a Dimensional Transfer Cannon
awaits them there.
They send Clavier in to disable it, and the plan
succeeds. Clavier then joins the battle,
and the base falls.
After the fighting, the group learns that the leylines transport
Dimensional Power extracted from the Earth.

scenario:577a9c497fd36f80.text:
Using information left at the Terminal Base, Clavier searches
for the whereabouts of the Sphere-equipped machines.
Shikuu, Reactor of the Taciturn Crab, then attacks.
Recognizing the overwhelming difference in strength, the group
helps the Resistance escape and withdraws from the base.
The group is dispirited, but Orion brings
news of the Virgola.

scenario:41f0da1a5485b6aa.text:
Setsuko and the others fight to reclaim the Virgola, but struggle
against the trap Gilter has prepared.
Setsuko temporarily awakens her Sphere's power, however,
and the Virgola Glory S responds, allowing her to
defeat him.

scenario:1b7b3923dcbfa7c6.text:
Rand vows to abstain from drinking as a pledge for his reunion
with Mel and the Gunleon. The stress, however,
turns him into The Crusher.
During the battle, Rand reunites with Mel and the Gunleon,
regains his composure, and awakens the Gunleon's
Magna Mode.

scenario:7bfcd69e5dcc141b.text:
Crowe confronts Advent with his doubts, but
Shikuu appears again.
Crowe fights to break through Shikuu's emptiness, but is
easily shot down. This triggers the arrival of the upgraded
Li Brasta from another dimension. With its power, Crowe
drives Shikuu away, but also finds himself burdened
with a new problem.

scenario:df1728a6e37eb2a4.text:
To liberate the northern Central Continent, the group attacks
the Central Base, the heart of the enemy's forces.
They repel Gilter, who commands the defenders,
and succeed in taking the base. Before their eyes, however,
Saldias reveals his true identity. He and Clavier, the Sphere Reactor
of the Resentful Scorpion, plunge the group into danger.
The group barely escapes the battlefield
at the cost of Red's life.
scenario:df1728a6e37eb2a4.notes: Avoid extending Saldias's true-identity reveal to Clavier through as does Clavier. The JP separately identifies Saldias revealing his identity and Clavier being the Scorpion Reactor, then makes both the cause of the group's danger. Recap 1015 reserves the true-Reactor revelation for Orion. The revision keeps Clavier's role at this point without adding a parallel true-identity revelation or implying an unmentioned voluntary confession.

scenario:b5b0dcddd9b4e2f6.text:
Saldias corners the group as they suffer from Clavier's poison.
They manage to repel him, only to face a desperate situation
when another pursuit force arrives under
Gilter's command.
The Asclepus awakens an unknown power and defeats Gilter,
but that same power transports the group
to Blue Earth.

scenario:f99413527bd72b5f.text:
On Blue Earth, the group encounters Gadlight of Geminis,
who attempts to win over the three Reactors for his own
purposes. Upon learning of Shikuu's presence, however,
Gadlight abandons the attempt and challenges them to battle.
Advent appears during the fighting and returns the group
to Green Earth.

scenario:aea8620e742e176c.text:
The group challenges the Central Base again and fights
Clavier. After their hard-fought victory, Orion tells them
that he is the true Reactor of the Resentful Scorpion.
He gives them a glimpse of his overwhelming power and departs.
Despite their many wounds, Setsuko and the others have liberated
the northern Central Continent. They part ways with Advent,
each resolving to continue the fight.

interface:bae2e3735dbf9f28.text:
The protagonist and Suzune attempt to infiltrate a town to free it from the New Earth Empire.
As the operation places Suzune under intense stress...

interface:2976cb76ae454027.text:
Shotaro and Watta receive a request from Koji's younger brother Shiro to find a kitten.
Meanwhile, an evil group waiting for its chance to rise again is about to make its move.

interface:1f0897ba5222c76d.text: The Door to a New Era

interface:4d9de60f9f3688fd.text:
Late in the Prison War, Riddhe learns his destiny and grows increasingly frustrated with Banagher.
Before the decisive battle with Char, Amuro puts the two and the other young Newtypes through training.

interface:a64cf5291e19f2d0.text:
Returning to school after a long absence, Sousuke angers Kaname with another misunderstanding.
When danger closes in on Kaname while she is alone, a strange animal (?) makes a dashing entrance.

interface:ba4b8849923bc45f.text:
Wufei continues to fight as part of the Resistance against the New Earth Empire's invasion.
As he fights for the people's pride and finds himself in danger, others who share his ideals appear.
interface:ba4b8849923bc45f.notes: Restore the explicit role レジスタンスとして. The draft conveys opposition to the invasion but omits that Wufei is acting as part of the Resistance. The following sentence and named parties are unchanged.

interface:7bfc85f0d0a75330.text:
Kappei cannot stop thinking about Nono's words: a true Super Robot pilot.
Seeking an answer, he receives advice from Takeru and Noriko.
interface:7bfc85f0d0a75330.notes: アドバイスをもらう states that Kappei receives advice; merely asking for it does not preserve that result. Keep the existing names and the preceding concern about Nono's words.

interface:d8e32b2a2f1770ab.text:
Zero intercepts the New Earth Empire's massive force as it approaches New Japan.
Then that man flies over Tokyo, now a battlefield, accompanied by his fiery sound.

interface:3136648cf21656df.text: Those Who Do Not Fight Shall Not Eat

interface:f97e4317af657213.text:
While enjoying a modest feast before a major battle, the group learns
that Gilter is attacking a Resistance food convoy, and their anger flares.

interface:5ba0e731777ac61e.text:
Struggling against the Empire, the Resistance draws hope from rumors of the Beast and the Wind.
Team D and Team Dai-Gurren fight hard to live up to those hopes.

interface:ade4148d25724646.text:
In UCW, just after the Executor Incident ends, Shinn and Kira still keep their distance.
They and Kamille, who worries about the pair, encounter a new Zeon.

interface:75dce5f4dfa3d285.text:
After the Prison War, Chirico loses Fyana and his reason to live.
One day, while going through the motions of Battling, he meets Kei again.

interface:f2be77442bff0c9e.text:
To disrupt Terminal Base under Saldias's command,
team members who rarely fight on the front lines put their individual talents to work.

interface:12daeb01487aaab5.text:
The Getter Team trains the Elements, who are shaken and disheartened.
Akagi invites Shinji and the others, who bear emotional scars of their own, to join the training.

interface:ac2df351bca0c19f.text:
An accident befalls Ledo upon his return to the Gargantia fleet.
Caught in a predicament, how will Ledo and Chamber face the approaching Sidereal forces?

interface:4b992da99f079e5d.text:
Recalling the days after the Executor Incident, Loran and Garrod
tell of their battle against mysterious mobile suits that emerged from a Mountain Cycle.

interface:2d65d22863ce9bd8.text:
Buster Machines have hearts and respond to their pilots' feelings...
Chico recalls competing with Nono for the seat of Quatre-Vingt-Dix's pilot.

interface:7ec3984f66de459f.text:
A chance incident leaves S.M.S. and Mithril's SRT glaring at one another.
Each group puts its pride on the line as they face the terrorists.

interface:5aa9a6e37a7a818c.text:
Graham and the others protect a civilian shuttle pursued by the New Earth Empire.
Aboard it, they meet someone with deep ties to Setsuna.

interface:16f4067e9d6fab62.text:
Roger and Banjou connect the words a future of despair with Paradigm City.
Together with Apollo, they seek the mysterious book Metropolis to learn the truth.

interface:94b6957e8cf59561.text:
The women's pride and determination clash as they settle grudges from the Prison War.
Once again, Miss Combat, or Miss Con for short, begins on a merciless battlefield.

interface:4aa211f6db64dc86.text:
AG prepares a special simulation stage before the battles to come.
Can the group triumph over the formidable foes of the past who now approach across the land?

interface:d5af662bece688aa.text:
AG prepares a special simulation stage before the battles to come.
Can the group triumph over the formidable foes of the past who now approach through space?

interface:43c8c8eaca6536b0.text:
Traveling to Mars, Crowe and the others encounter remnants of Firebug.
Before Marilyn Cat's grave, Firebug's final battle begins.

interface:84699e17be081cff.text:
AG prepares an extra-special simulation stage before the decisive battle.
Can the group triumph over the formidable foes of the past who wield Dimensional Power?
